label: CBS: IB applicants through optagelse.dk

rounds.label: CBS application with an international upper-secondary examination
rounds.note: There is no later round for IB holders. The 5 July deadline that Danish-qualified applicants use does not apply to you.

milestones.label: Optagelse.dk opens for the 2027 intake
milestones.note: CBS states that optagelse.dk opens on 1 February; annual day/month rule, confirm for 2027.

milestones.label: Applications close
milestones.note: Twelve noon, not midnight. Applies to every applicant with an international or IB qualification, whether the diploma was earned in Denmark or abroad, and whether you are aiming at quota 1 or quota 2.

milestones.label: CBS: sign with MitID or email your signature page
milestones.note: With MitID, sign each application online. Without MitID, personally sign the PDF and email it from your optagelse.dk registered email to signaturepage@cbs.dk by noon. Postal alternative must be postmarked by 14 March; it does not use this email deadline.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Provisional May 2027 IB results date; check the IB calendar for confirmation. Arrange CBS online results access; this date does not waive a CBS documentation deadline.

milestones.label: Offers and quota 1 cut-offs published
milestones.note: Every programme's cut-off average is published the same day. Vacant places appear in the same week.

milestones.label: CBS: arrange IB online results access (000151)
milestones.note: Ask your IB coordinator shortly after May exams to grant CBS access. CBS publishes no separate registration date; no invented March target.

milestones.label: CBS: already completed qualification documents
milestones.note: Explicit 2027 rule: if you completed upper secondary education by 15 March, upload official diploma, transcript and supporting qualification documents by noon.

milestones.label: CBS: quota 2 essay and activity evidence
milestones.note: One self-written English PDF essay per programme; essay and activities count only if at least three months have passed since school completion.

milestones.label: CBS: remaining entry evidence; priorities
milestones.note: Entry evidence generally due noon for applicants still completing school; already-completed qualification documents are due in March. Same-year IB results must be accessed online (000151). Residence-permit applicants have the separate March rule; no late-results assurance. Non-EU/EEA applicants subject to the March application/document deadline because they need a student residence permit cannot reorder priorities after 15 March.

milestones.label: CBS: entry documents for applicants needing a student residence permit
milestones.note: Only non-EU/EEA applicants who need a student residence permit for Denmark; final qualification evidence is due noon. The source does not explicitly reconcile this with same-year IB results access in July: obtain CBS confirmation before planning on this intake.

readerAccess.reason: Only applicants needing a student residence permit for Denmark; same-year IB timing requires CBS confirmation.

milestones.label: CBS: confirm your place
milestones.note: CBS states 1 August 23:59 without an intake year; follow the deadline in the admission letter.

submissionItems.label: Submit up to eight ranked programme choices
Authorise CBS 000151 in the IB online results service
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: IB results service, Copenhagen Business School (000151)
submissionItems.note: Arrange shortly after May exams; this is the only accepted same-year IB Diploma result route.

submissionItems.label: Official IB diploma and results (include first results after a retake)
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: optagelse.dk; same-year results through the IB online service
submissionItems.note: Already graduated by 15 March: official qualification documents due 15 March 2027 noon. Otherwise use the applicable document deadline; no separate IB predicted-grade deadline is published in the pages read.

submissionItems.label: Eligible quota 2 essay and activity documents
Passport or national ID; residence evidence where relevant
Sign with MitID or personally email the signed signature-page PDF
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: optagelse.dk with MitID; otherwise signaturepage@cbs.dk from your registered email
submissionItems.note: Postal alternative must be postmarked by 14 March. Keep the email automatic receipt.

supplementarySteps: Apply by 15 March noon with an international qualification, even if studied in Denmark.
Without MitID, personally sign and email the signature page to signaturepage@cbs.dk from your optagelse.dk registered email by 15 March noon. Postal alternative must be postmarked by 14 March.
Annual dates without a year remain provisional for 2027. Confirm the reply deadline in the offer.
Non-EU/EEA applicants needing a student residence permit must clarify final-IB timing with CBS; no exception to the March documentation rule is established here.

notes: CBS-specific route replaces generic national assumptions for these six Opportunities. Canonical IB result-calendar pointer and provisional state retained. No fixed predicted-grade deadline found.
